meta.name: triage
meta.description: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles — categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将问题与外部PR自动流转、分类、验证，并产出agent简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护着活跃代码仓库，需要高效分流大量 issue 和 PR
copy.tagline_en: Automate triage of issues and external PRs, with agent-ready briefs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain an active repo and need to triage many issues and PRs

howto.what: 这项技能会帮你整理项目的问题列表：自动把问题归类为「缺陷」或「改进」，打上「待分诊」「等待回复」「可交给代理」等状态标签；还会查询待处理问题、检查重复或已拒绝的请求、验证描述是否属实，最后发布说明或关闭问题。
howto.when: 当维护者在聊天中发送 `/triage` 并描述需求时触发，例如「显示待处理的问题」「查看 #42」「把 #42 移到 ready-for-agent」等。

say.text: 显示需要我注意的问题
say.note: 列出未标记、待分诊及有新回复的问题
直接应用状态，并询问是否写 agent brief

say.text: 分诊 #42，验证这个 bug 是否属实
say.note: 先查代码库、验证声明，再给建议

howto.what_en: This skill tidies issues: auto-categorises as bug or enhancement, applies state labels (needs-triage, needs-info, ready-for-agent), queries outstanding items, checks duplicates/rejections, verifies claims, then posts notes or closes.
howto.when_en: When the maintainer sends /triage in chat and describes a need, e.g. "show items needing attention", "look at #42", "move #42 to ready-for-agent".

say_en.text: Show me the issues that need my attention
say_en.note: Lists unlabeled, needs-triage, and issues with new replies.
Applies the state directly, asks whether to write an agent brief.

say_en.text: Triage #42 and verify whether this bug is real
say_en.note: Checks codebase, verifies claim, then recommends.
